commands:
set -euo pipefail
HOME_DIR="$HOME"
REG="$HOME_DIR/Library/Application Support/local-agent/repositories.json"
BACKUP="$HOME_DIR/Library/Application Support/local-agent/repositories.json.pre-litegraph-layout-20260825"
OLD_ROOT="$HOME_DIR/agent-workspace"
NEW_ROOT="$OLD_ROOT/repos/litegraph"
OLD_WORK="$OLD_ROOT/work"
OLD_CONTROL="$OLD_ROOT/control"
OLD_CHECKPOINTS="$OLD_ROOT/checkpoints"
NEW_WORK="$NEW_ROOT/work"
NEW_CONTROL="$NEW_ROOT/control"
NEW_CHECKPOINTS="$NEW_ROOT/checkpoints"

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
home = Path.home()
reg = home / 'Library' / 'Application Support' / 'local-agent' / 'repositories.json'
payload = json.loads(reg.read_text())
repos = payload.get('repositories', [])
lg = [r for r in repos if r.get('id') == 'litegraph']
assert len(lg) == 1, f'expected one litegraph entry, got {len(lg)}'
assert lg[0].get('repository') == 'MichalMatu/esp32s3_LiteGraph'
assert lg[0].get('legacy_workspace') is True, f'unexpected legacy flag: {lg[0].get(

)!r}'
for p in [home/'agent-workspace'/'work', home/'agent-workspace'/'control', home/'agent-workspace'/'checkpoints']:
    assert p.exists(), f'missing source: {p}'
assert not (home/'agent-workspace'/'repos'/'litegraph').exists(), 'destination already exists'
PY

git -C "$OLD_WORK" diff --quiet
git -C "$OLD_WORK" diff --cached --quiet
git -C "$OLD_CONTROL" diff --quiet
git -C "$OLD_CONTROL" diff --cached --quiet
cp -p "$REG" "$BACKUP"
mkdir -p "$NEW_ROOT"
MOVED_WORK=0; MOVED_CONTROL=0; MOVED_CHECKPOINTS=0; REG_CHANGED=0
rollback() {
  rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then return; fi
  echo "migration failed rc=$rc; rolling back" >&2
  if [ "$REG_CHANGED" -eq 1 ] && [ -f "$BACKUP" ]; then cp -p "$BACKUP" "$REG" || true; fi
  if [ "$MOVED_CONTROL" -eq 1 ] && [ -e "$NEW_CONTROL" ] && [ ! -e "$OLD_CONTROL" ]; then mv "$NEW_CONTROL" "$OLD_CONTROL" || true; fi
  if [ "$MOVED_CHECKPOINTS" -eq 1 ] && [ -e "$NEW_CHECKPOINTS" ] && [ ! -e "$OLD_CHECKPOINTS" ]; then mv "$NEW_CHECKPOINTS" "$OLD_CHECKPOINTS" || true; fi
  if [ "$MOVED_WORK" -eq 1 ] && [ -e "$NEW_WORK" ] && [ ! -e "$OLD_WORK" ]; then mv "$NEW_WORK" "$OLD_WORK" || true; fi
  rmdir "$NEW_ROOT" 2>/dev/null || true
  exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback EXIT

mv "$OLD_WORK" "$NEW_WORK"; MOVED_WORK=1
mv "$OLD_CHECKPOINTS" "$NEW_CHECKPOINTS"; MOVED_CHECKPOINTS=1
mv "$OLD_CONTROL" "$NEW_CONTROL"; MOVED_CONTROL=1

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
home = Path.home()
reg = home / 'Library' / 'Application Support' / 'local-agent' / 'repositories.json'
payload = json.loads(reg.read_text())
for item in payload['repositories']:
    if item.get('id') == 'litegraph':
        if item.get('legacy_workspace') is not True:
            raise SystemExit('litegraph legacy_workspace changed during migration')
        item.pop('legacy_workspace', None)
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit('litegraph registry entry missing')
text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n'
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='repositories.', suffix='.tmp', dir=reg.parent)
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(text); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, reg)
finally:
    try: os.unlink(tmp)
    except FileNotFoundError: pass
PY
REG_CHANGED=1

cd "$HOME_DIR/local-agent"
python3 agent_repo_admin.py --registry "$REG" validate --repository-id litegraph
python3 agent_repo_admin.py --registry "$REG" list --repository-id litegraph
[ -d "$NEW_WORK/.git" ]
[ -d "$NEW_CONTROL/.git" ]
[ -d "$NEW_CHECKPOINTS" ]
[ ! -e "$OLD_WORK" ]
[ ! -e "$OLD_CONTROL" ]
[ ! -e "$OLD_CHECKPOINTS" ]

trap - EXIT
echo 'MIGRATION_OK'
echo '--- registry ---'
cat "$REG"
echo '--- new paths ---'
for p in "$NEW_WORK" "$NEW_CONTROL" "$NEW_CHECKPOINTS"; do printf '%s\t' "$p"; du -sh "$p"; done
echo "backup=$BACKUP"
